success.description: A You vomit a stream of maggots, bile, and other filth all over the target engagement. All creatures in that engagement are hit for &To + WP damage, ignoring the soak value of armour.

boon.description: Each character that suffers at least one wound from this attack must make a Disease 2 check.

conservative.requirements: 7 power, target engagement within close range. Your mouth must be uncovered. This check is the highest Toughness in the target engagement. Each creature in the engagement with Resilience trained adds {Dc} to the dice pool.
conservative.name: Stream of Corruption
